caption: The drawing depicts a bouquet of flowers arranged in a fan shape, bound together at the base with a pink and white striped ribbon tied into a bow. The bouquet includes a variety of flowers, such as yellow, pink, red, and white blossoms, as well as small blue flowers. The leaves are green and interspersed among the flowers. Some flower heads are round, while others are star-shaped or clustered in small groups. The background is a dark, muted gradient, giving depth to the composition, and the central part of the bouquet is more brightly colored, making the flowers and ribbon stand out against the darker backdrop. The image is bordered by a thin black line, and the artist's name "A. Jordan" is written in small letters in the lower left corner outside the border.
title: Crewel Wreath
